$comment: A pikelet shelf: a static listing of knowledge packs. No service, no accounts - the registry is also just a file. Mount everything on it with: npx pikelet mcp --shelf <path-or-url-to-this-file>. Entries: name (optional mount name), url or path (relative paths resolve against this file's location), identity (optional sha256 manifest identity - mounts refuse a pack that does not match), description, license.

packs.name: simple-wikipedia
packs.description: Simple English Wikipedia, 456,153 passages with inline MiniLM encoder, hybrid retrieval, and calibrated abstention. ~649 MiB served by range reads: mounting transfers ~52 MiB and each question costs ~127 range requests - nothing downloads the whole file.
